An evening that stays – thanks to Alessio Rasom and his great team
Jan 2026 • Friends
Our visit to SI Dining Da Nang was not just a dinner – it was an evening full of atmosphere, depth and genuine hospitality.

What makes this place special is the palpable signature of Alessio Rasom. You can see in every detail how much passion, precision and personality have gone into this – from the kitchen to the service and the extraordinary sense of space. Alessio is present, attentive and manages to make you feel not as a guest but as a welcome part of the place.

Architecturally, the SI is a real statement: the structured green wall, the warm wood, the finely tuned light and the interplay of interior and exterior create a calm, almost meditative atmosphere. A space that slows down – and at the same time inspires.

Culinary delights of the SI impress across the board: clear, creative, high-quality. Each course is precisely composed, tastefully balanced and implemented with great respect for product and craftsmanship. Nothing seems random, nothing cluttered – exactly the kind of cuisine that inspires lasting enthusiasm. The wine accompaniment is carefully selected and completes the experience perfectly.

The service is attentive, warm and professional – present without ever being intrusive. Just the way you want it.

Conclusion:
The SI Dining is a place with soul, attitude and character. A place for special evenings, good conversations and real enjoyment.
We will definitely be back – and are already looking forward to it.

The Signature menu is a must have! Gastronomic fireworks in Danang
Jul 2025 • Friends
I went here, after Si dining was highly recommended by a friend of mine. I must say, I was blown away by the experience and the food. Italian cuisine, but using very special local ingredients and really masterful wine pairings were administered with great skill and charm. I had the signature tasting menu and some of these dishes were comparable to 2 star and 3 star Michelin dishes. Highlights for me were the Cheese Ravioli with black truffle, pairing by a very silky Italian Pinot Noir and I also absolutely loved the Pigeon with beetroot. The Chardonnay that was served by Trinh - the talented sommelier - really elevated and rounded out the dish. Highly recommended. I think this place deserves a Michelin star. Or maybe two....

A piece of Italy in Da Nang
Aug 2025 • Friends
I had the pleasure of dining at Si Dining in Da Nang and the experience was truly memorable. The restaurant is elegant but at the same time welcoming, with attentive and friendly Service.

The cuisine offers an interesting encounter between Italian tradition and Asian influences. Among the dishes tried, the ravioli with gorgonzola and truffle were undoubtedly the highlight of the evening: creamy, fragrant and perfectly balanced in flavors. A refined combination that demonstrates great care in the choice of raw materials.

Overall, a restaurant that I recommend both to those looking for a different gastronomic experience than usual, and to lovers of Italian cuisine looking for quality even outside Italy. 

An address not to be missed in Da Nang! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
